title: Departure-relative messages: rules that send a template to everyone on a departure N days before or after, with each person's own pickup point and time, through the Communication Hub, respecting consent, opt-out and caps
goal: An agency sets 'extras reminder 7 days before', 'pickup time 2 days before at 18:00' and 'review request 2 days after' once; every departure then sends (or proposes) the right message to each booking or passenger with their own details, exactly once.
why: Gap 5: today this is a manual bulk send by tag and everyone gets the full pickup list. Design: TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md section 9.3.

edit: backend/src/index.ts (one routeMounts line and one requireFeature line)

steps: services/messaging/hub.ts sendHubMessage(env, tenantId, db, {contactId, leadId?, channel, templateId?|body, subject?, variables, purpose: service|marketing, actorId|null}): the body of POST /communications/send moved out (destination, metering with tryMeter and AllowanceExhausted, message_log, queueing, reply-to, WhatsApp template jobs), plus the consent rule: marketing -> marketingBlockedReason blocks; service -> blocked only by email_undeliverable or no address. The route calls it and answers exactly as before (existing communications tests are the guard).

Routes /departure-message-rules (feature group_departures): CRUD per design 3.1 columns, POST /:id/preview?departureId= renders per-person messages without sending; seeds three inactive default rules (extras reminder 7 days before, pickup time 2 days before, review request 2 days after the end with purpose marketing) when group_tours is first enabled.

template-engine.ts resolveVariables gains an optional departure context {seatBookingId, passengerId?} and the variables of design 9.3 (tour_name, departure_date, departure_code, return_date, pickup_point, pickup_time, pickup_address, seat_count, passenger_names, room_type, balance_due, tour_leader_name, tour_leader_phone; extras_link and details_link exist since R150), formatted with the agency locale; unknown variables stay as today.

scheduled-messages.ts and cron job 'departures.messages' (period tick): for each active rule and each open, departed or completed departure, due = anchor date + offset at local_time in the tenant zone; when due has passed and is less than 48 h old, process the audience (confirmed, confirmed_and_held or waitlisted; booking contact or each passenger with a phone/email): INSERT OR IGNORE into departure_message_sends first (the unique key makes reruns harmless), then auto -> sendHubMessage (status sent, skipped_opt_out, skipped_cap, skipped_no_address or failed; one staff notification per run when the cap is hit), suggest -> one assistant suggestion per departure 'Review and send N messages' opening the per-person list. WhatsApp without an approved template uses the rule's fallback channel.
Recipe entry departures.scheduled_messages (featureKey group_departures) so the rules show on the automations page with their mode.

Settings > Group tours > Scheduled messages: list of rules (name, when, template, audience, recipient, purpose, mode, active), add/edit dialog (template via RelationCombobox over message templates, channel and fallback, anchor and offset with a plain sentence preview 'Sends 2 days before departure at 18:00'), preview against a chosen departure; per-tour overrides on the tour page.
Templates page: the variable picker lists the departure variables (only when the feature and agency switch are on).

tests: backend/test/hub-sender.test.ts: the route and the function give the same results for a service and a marketing message; consent blocks marketing only; cap exhausted -> AllowanceExhausted.

backend/test/departure-messages.test.ts: due time computed in Europe/Amsterdam and Asia/Kolkata; per-passenger pickup point and time in the body; each person gets their own; rerun of the job sends nothing twice; opted-out contact skipped for marketing but not for a service pickup message; cap hit -> skipped_cap with one notification; suggest mode creates one suggestion; 48 h late window respected; waitlisted audience.

e2e/departure-messages.spec.ts: enable the pickup rule in auto mode, run the scheduled job through the test route (or the automations 'Run daily checks now'), see one message per passenger in the outbox/simulator with their own pickup time; preview shows the same.
acceptance: Each passenger receives their own pickup time once; consent and caps are respected; no message is sent twice.

productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere.
Feature switch: group_departures plus the agency switch on the routes, the job and the screens.
All sends go through the Communication Hub domain sender; consent, opt-out and communication caps apply; nothing bypasses metering.
Automations through the engine (recipes, cron/dispatch.ts); idempotent per rule, departure, booking and passenger.
Desktop: CONTRACT.md; RelationCombobox; t() with en and nl keys in departureMessages.json; RTL-safe classes; dates through lib/dates.ts.
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test.
